ModDescription:
[h3]FreeBuild Unlimited[/h3]
Snap / support / floating + collision / overlap in one overlay.

[b]Why INSTALL_OVERLAY.bat?[/b] Steam only downloads the files. The bat copies the overlay into Content\Paks. It does not change the main game pak. Run once after subscribe.

Setup: Subscribe → launch and close once → open WS\Mods\FreeBuildUnlimited → run INSTALL_OVERLAY.bat → Mods Apply → restart.

Use this mod alone — unsubscribe old FreeBuild / FreeBuild No Collision.

To remove: run UNINSTALL_OVERLAY.bat and unsubscribe.
ModChangenotes: v1.0.0: Merged FreeBuildNoSnapSupport + FreeBuildNoCollision into a single _1_P overlay.
